remarks:
Welcome to one of Western New York's most extraordinary waterfront estates, where timeless craftsmanship, unmatched privacy, and sweeping Lake Erie views come together to create a truly unforgettable property. Set across two parcels totaling approximately 1.52 acres, this remarkable estate offers over 5,000 square feet of living space, five bedrooms, three full bathrooms, one half bath, and an unparalleled setting along the shoreline.

From the moment you arrive, the mature trees, expansive grounds, and impressive curb appeal hint at what awaits inside. Designed to celebrate its breathtaking waterfront setting, the home is filled with oversized windows that capture panoramic views of Lake Erie from nearly every principal room.

The spectacular great room serves as the heart of the home, featuring dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows, stunning slate flooring, custom built-ins, and an impressive brick fireplace that perfectly frames the ever-changing beauty of the lake beyond. Whether enjoying a peaceful morning sunrise or an unforgettable evening sunset, the views become part of everyday living.

The chef's kitchen is equally impressive, showcasing soaring vaulted ceilings with skylights, premium appliances, abundant custom cabinetry, a generous center island, and expansive water views that make every meal feel extraordinary. Designed for both entertaining and everyday living, the thoughtful floor plan offers multiple gathering spaces, generous bedroom accommodations, and three fireplaces that add warmth and character throughout the home.

Step outside to experience your own private waterfront retreat. The beautifully manicured grounds provide exceptional space for entertaining, relaxing, or simply taking in the sights and sounds of Lake Erie.

Properties of this caliber are exceptionally rare, Comprised of two parcels extending from the road to the Lake Erie shoreline, the property offers complete street-to-water ownership. Whether envisioned as a year-round residence, luxury retreat, or legacy property to be enjoyed for generations, this offering presents an extraordinary opportunity to own one of Lake Erie's premier waterfront homes.
